Tax Exempt Purchasing

From the ORA eTraining module "Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects" (lesson 3 of 15).
Morgan State University: Tax Exempt Purchasing
Morgan State University, under the umbrella of the State of Maryland, maintains tax-exempt status for procuring goods and services. There are limited exceptions to this policy including hotel/lodging taxes and car rental tax fees assessed while on university-approved travel. All purchases made in Maryland using the MSU Purchasing Card (P-Card) outside of these limited exceptions should be tax free. For accidental tax charges the cardholder must work with the vendor to receive a refund.
Morgan's Tax Exempt ID # is 30002563 and is noted on your purchasing card.
Tax-Exempt Forms
To obtain a completed tax exempt form for your chosen vendor please contact the MSU Procurement department by emailing services.procurement@morgan.edu .
